LanguageData.RHAH_Faction_Hostile.label: hostile famine ratkin
LanguageData.RHAH_Faction_Hostile.description: These ratkin fled settlements ruined by famine and have little food left. They are hostile to the colony and may attack colonists.
LanguageData.RHAH_Faction_LeaningHostile.label: wary famine ratkin
LanguageData.RHAH_Faction_LeaningHostile.description: These ratkin fled settlements ruined by famine. They watch the colony warily. If a colonist hurts one of them, the accompanying visitors may turn hostile together.
LanguageData.RHAH_Faction_Neutral.label: famine ratkin
LanguageData.RHAH_Faction_Neutral.description: These ratkin fled settlements ruined by famine. Some beg, some steal, and some are merely passing through. They are currently neutral toward the colony. Forced expulsion may make the accompanying visitors turn hostile together.
LanguageData.RHAH_Faction_LeaningFriendly.label: approachable famine ratkin
LanguageData.RHAH_Faction_LeaningFriendly.description: These ratkin fled settlements ruined by famine and are willing to approach the colony for food. If a colonist hurts one of them, the accompanying visitors may leave together.
LanguageData.RHAH_Faction_Friendly.label: friendly famine ratkin
LanguageData.RHAH_Faction_Friendly.description: These ratkin fled settlements ruined by famine and are friendly toward the colony. Once you mark a relief area, they look for food there. If a colonist hurts one of them, the accompanying visitors may leave together.
